description.p: FlatCAM is a 2D post-processing tool for manufacturing printed circuit boards (PCBs). It reads Gerber, Excellon and G-Code files and generates the tool paths needed to isolate traces, drill holes, cut out boards and produce the final G-Code for your CNC machine or engraver.

ul.li: Import Gerber, Excellon and G-Code files
Non-copper region clearing and paint area toolpaths
Scripting through an integrated command shell

description.p: This is a fork of the original FlatCAM by Juan Pablo Caram, updated to run on modern Linux with PyQt5.
Development snapshot built from the project's git branch (not an official upstream release). Packaged as a Flatpak with a pure-Python command shell that removes the Tcl/Tk dependency.
